title: Quentin and the Crown Anew
author: Hazel Pemberton
blurb: Cyrus Almeida, a debt-bound temple scribe, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when the old gods begin answering prayers again, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
